entities.name: Varangians & the Foundation of Rus'
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Swedish Vikings sailing east via the river systems of Russia, the semi-legendary Rurik's founding of the Rus' state at Novgorod (862), and the establishment of the trade route 'from the Varangians to the Greeks' linking Scandinavia to Byzantium.
